formal_statement: ∀ (m l h : ℕ) (π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinClause (Fin m × Fin l))), 1 ≤ h → PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinRefutation (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.BPHP m l) π → ∃ (M W : ℕ) (g : Fin M → Fin W → MvPolynomial (Fin m × Fin l) (ZMod 2)), M ≤ 3 * π.length + m.choose 2 ∧ (∀ (j : Fin M) (i : Fin W), (g j i).totalDegree ≤ 1) ∧ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PCRefutable (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.blockSystem (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.bitPHPSystem m l) h M W g) (max (2 * h + l) (4 * h + 1))
plain_statement: A Res(+) refutation of BPHP m l with S lines gives at most 3S + C(m,2) blocks of accuracy h with affine inputs and a PC refutation of degree max(2h + l, 4h + 1) of the bit system extended by the blocks (Theorem 7.9).
title: Chain C: a Res(+) refutation of bit pigeonhole gives a low-degree PC refutation with one block of extension variables per line
